questions.prompt: Ntasinzira rwose; ahubwo akora ku manywa na nijoro. Sinzi uko abishobora.
questions.answer: He doesn't sleep at all; to the contrary he works day and night. I don't know how he does it.

questions.prompt: Gerageza kwibuka aho wabishyize. Oya, simbishobora.
questions.answer: Try to remember where you put them. No, I can't/am not able.

questions.prompt: Aya magambo aramukwiriye kuko ar'umuntu ugerageza rwose.
questions.answer: These words befit her, because she is a person who really tries.

questions.prompt: Ntituzi aho akura imbaraga yo gukora atyo. N'igitangaza rwose! Tuzareba uko abirangiza.
questions.answer: We don't know where she gets the energy to work like that. It's truly amazing! We'll see how she finishes it.

questions.prompt: Sinibuka ubwo asinzira, kuko atabibwira umuntu wese.
questions.answer: I don't remember when he sleeps, because he doesn't tell anyone.

questions.prompt: Uyu muntu ntasinzira ku manywa cyangwa nijoro, ahubwo ahora agira umurimo akora.
questions.answer: This person does not sleep day nor night; to the contrary, he constantly has work he does.

questions.prompt: Ntibazi yuko batabishobora, ariko bazabigerageza nubwo badafite imbaraga yo kubikora.
questions.answer: They don't know that they cannot do it, but they will try even though they don't have the energy to do it.

questions.prompt: Kuko ari umuntu ukora ibitangaza, abantu benshi bazizera yuko ari Kristo.
questions.answer: Because he is a person who does wonders, many people will believe that he is Christ.

questions.prompt: Sinkwiriye kugenda ubu; ahubwo nkwiriye gusinzira. Ni nsinzira none, ejo nzagira imbaraga yo gutangira urugendo.
questions.answer: I should not go now; to the contrary, I should sleep. If I sleep today, tomorrow I'll have the energy to begin the journey.

questions.prompt: Nkwiriye kurya, kuko ari he nkura imbaraga.
questions.answer: I must eat, because that's where I derive (my) energy.

questions.prompt: Ntabwo amenya byose biri mw isi. Hariho umwe wabimenye uhereye kera, kandi azabimenya iteka. Iyi si n'ishira azamenya itangiriro ryayo.
questions.answer: He certainly doesn't know everything on earth. There is one who knew it from long ago, and he will know it forever. When this earth ends, He will know its beginning.

questions.prompt: Ntidushobora gukora kuruta Petero. N'ukuri akora ibitangaza kuruta abandi bose.
questions.answer: We can't do better than Peter. Truly he does greater wonders than everyone else.

questions.prompt: Ntashobora gukora ibitangaza kuko atar'Imana.
questions.answer: She can't work miracles, because she is not God.

questions.prompt: Mukwiriye kwibuka izina rye, kuko ar'umuntu mukuru, kandi afite imbaraga zo kubafasha.
questions.answer: You should remember his name, because he is an important person, and he has the power to help you.

questions.prompt: Simpinga mu gitondo, ahubwo nsinzira kugira ngo mbone imbaraga zo kubishobora nimunsi.
questions.answer: I don't hoe in the morning; to the contrary, I sleep so that I can find the energy to be able to do it in the afternoon.

questions.prompt: Iri juru n'iyi si bizashira, ariko har'ibiriho bizahoraho iteka ryose.
questions.answer: Heaven and earth will pass away, but there are things that exist which will continue to exist forever.

questions.prompt: Sinzi uko nzabishobora, ariko nzabigerageza. Ni mbikora ntyo, ndagira ngo nzabishobora nanjye.
questions.answer: I don't know how I will be able (to do it), but I will try (it). If I do it like this, I suppose I will be able (to do it).

questions.prompt: Bibiliya ivuga yuko ntaho Imana itari/itaba, ahubwo ngo ituzi twese; ndetse ibara n'umusatsi wose wo ku mitwe yacu.
questions.answer: The Bible says that there is nowhere that God is not; to the contrary, He knows all of us; He even knows each hair on our heads.

questions.prompt: Sinakibitse munsi y'ikirago; ahubwo kiri hejuru yacyo.
questions.answer: I didn't store it under the rug; to the contrary, it is on top of it.

questions.prompt: Nkwiriye kuvuga amagambo amukwiriye, kuko ar'umuntu ugerageza cyane.
questions.answer: I must say words that are worthy of her, because she is a person who tries hard.

questions.prompt: Gira utya, oya, s'utyo. Niba utabikora utya ntuzabishobora.
questions.answer: Do (it) like this; no, not like that. If you don't do it like this, you will not succeed.

questions.prompt: Nkura imbaraga mu magambo ambwira. Sinzi yuko nzashobora gukomeza niba ntayumva iminsi yose.
questions.answer: I derive strength from the words he tells me. I don't know if I will be able to continue if I don't hear them every day.

questions.prompt: Amagambo ambwira ni yo mbaraga ngira ku manywa na nijoro.
questions.answer: The words he tells me are the strength I have by day and by night.

questions.prompt: Oya, sindabigerageza; ariko nzi yuko nzabishobora kuko ampa imbaraga zinkwiriye.
questions.answer: No, I have not tried (it) yet; but I know that I will succeed because he gives me the strength I need (must (have)).

questions.prompt: Nubwo, batazi yuko batabishobora, bazabigerageza kuko bizera yuko bafite imbaraga zo kubikora.
questions.answer: Even though they don't know that they are not able (to do it), they will try (to do it), because they believe they have the strength to do it.

questions.prompt: Barigisha yuko Satani azakora ibitangaza, ndetse ngo azashobora gukora ibintu abantu badashobora.
questions.answer: They are teaching that Satan will work miracles, even that he will even be able to do things people cannot do.

questions.prompt: Nubwo atari byiza, tuzabigerageza ejo mu gitondo. Ndetse na none turabigerageza.
questions.answer: Even though it is not good, we will try (to do it) tomorrow morning. We will even try today (to do it).

questions.prompt: Ndamukunda kuruta byose; ndetse ndamukunda kuruta uko nkunda Imana nubwo nzi yuko atari byiza.
questions.answer: I love her more than everything, I even love her more than I love God, even though I know that is not good.

questions.prompt: Nta muntu n'umwe uzemera kubikora ejo. Ku mpamvu z'ibyo rero, dukwiriye gutuma Yohana none abandi bataraza.
questions.answer: Not a single person will agree to do it tomorrow. For that reason, then, we must send John today before the others come.

questions.prompt: Sinshaka kugutera ubwoba, ariko dukwiriye kwitonda cyane ngo tutayoba inzira, kuko har'inyamaswa nyinshi mur'iri shyamba.
questions.answer: I don't want to make you afraid, but we must be very careful not to lose [our] way, because there are many animals in this forest.

questions.prompt: Dukwiriye kumvira itegeko ryose riva mu biro bye, kuko bizatuma amahoro agaruka.
questions.answer: We should obey every command/law that comes from his office, because it will cause peace to return.
